title: Names and values with accents, Greek, Japanese and an emoji
how: The footprint name, the reference, the value and the net name hold characters outside ASCII; strings are read as UTF-8 and counted in characters for the position.
One footprint = 1 component with 2 pads; net 1 is the only net; pad 1 names net 1 and pad 2 names none = 1 pad net.
